hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a custom AMM curve where swaps are settled by depositing input tokens into and withdrawing output tokens from Euler Finance lending vaults. It uses beforeSwapReturnsDelta to fully handle swap execution, bypassing standard Uniswap v4 concentrated liquidity; beforeAddLiquidity and beforeDonate revert to prevent non-productive positions.
